question: What is the performance reported for the best models in the VLSP 2018 and VLSP 2019 challenges?
title: VAIS ASR: Building a conversational speech recognition system using language model combination
answer_short: 4.85% WER for VLSP 2018 and 15.09% WER for VLSP 2019
answer_rationale: The performance for the best models in the VLSP 2018 and VLSP 2019 challenges is explicitly reported in Text 1 and Text 5, which state that the best result for VLSP 2018 was 4.85% WER and for VLSP 2019 was 15.09% WER, achieved through system combination techniques.
